name: Temporal Halo
description: Always-on temporal HALO.md context + cron-driven dreaming

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: If false, the plugin will not inject HALO or enable dream helpers.

dreamMarker.label: Dream Marker
dreamMarker.help: If the agent prompt contains this marker, the plugin injects dream instructions.

fullRefreshMarker.label: Full Refresh Marker
fullRefreshMarker.help: If the prompt contains this marker, the plugin injects on-demand full refresh instructions.

maxChars.label: Max HALO chars
maxChars.help: Hard cap for HALO.md on disk. Publish attempts above this are rejected.

compactTargetChars.label: Compaction target chars
compactTargetChars.help: If a publish attempt is oversize, the agent is instructed to compact to this target.
